crime: At her father's funeral, {WITCH_NAME} smiled at the mourners. "What's wrong with your face?" an aunt asked, and the whole row turned. She never let anyone see her own face again.

In the prison, one girl photographed a different prisoner every day and posted the portrait to the chat each evening. Only {WITCH_NAME}'s face was missing from her album. Then, in the courtyard during afternoon free time, the girl caught that real face on her phone. She scraped her cheek on the fountain rim and laughed. "Got you."
That evening she posted it to the chat, and the whole lounge looked up from their phones at {WITCH_NAME}. "Tomorrow I'll catch you smiling," the girl promised.
In the library, as the girl photographed the unwilting cherry tree, {WITCH_NAME} twisted her phone lanyard from behind until the girl went still.

Minutes before lockup, the girl's roommate stood in the courtyard below the upper railing and called for her. The roommate looked up, saw the girl at the railing smiling and waving, and waited by the fountain, relieved. Moments later, {WITCH_NAME} walked into the lounge and stayed there in full view of the others until lockup.
At the trial, the prisoners placed the death after that sighting. {WITCH_NAME} had already been in the lounge, so suspicion fell on the girls upstairs.
Then a prisoner pointed to the plaster still on the dead girl's grazed cheek. The roommate had seen a bare, smiling cheek.

Before going to the lounge, {WITCH_NAME} had stepped up to the railing, into the roommate's frightened gaze, nodded, and stepped back. The prisoners understood: her Magic had shown the roommate the face she most needed.
fields.epitaph: Everyone else wanted a face that comforted them. Only one girl ever wanted hers.
fields.epithet: The Girl Whose Face Was Always Someone Else's Comfort
execution: The execution stand rose in the trial court: an open grave with a row of veiled iron mourners standing around it. She was strapped upright inside the grave. All at once, the whole row turned their heads toward her face. Then the mourners began tipping shovelfuls of grave earth onto her, and the earth climbed toward her upturned face until it closed over it. The row went on looking at a smooth mound.

magic.name: The Face You Need
magic.text: Her Magic shows everyone who looks at her the face that comforts them most.
